_provenance.notes: Under Alaska Statute AS 43.76, commercial fishermen in designated aquaculture regions vote to self-assess a 2% or 3% Salmon Enhancement Tax (SET) on the ex-vessel value of all commercial salmon landed. The revenues collected by the Alaska Department of Revenue are remitted directly to regional PNP aquaculture associations (PWSAC, SSRAA, NSRAA, KRAA, CIAA) to fund salmon hatchery operations, wild stock enhancement, and regional fish restoration projects.
